message.content: This editorial illustration features the masthead "TEMPO" in large red letters at the top. Below the title, a central illustration shows a large man with yellow skin, black hair, and a yellow collared shirt. He is pulling a long brown strap or belt that is wrapped around the middle of a tall, light-green skyscraper. The belt is cinched so tightly that the building's structure is compressed and narrow in the middle, creating an hourglass shape. The man has his hands gripped firmly on the end of the strap and is leaning back, showing physical effort. In the background, two more skyscrapers of similar design stand unaffected. The foreground contains shorter, rectangular brown buildings. The background sky is a pale green with light yellow, horizontal cloud-like streaks. Text on the right reads "BOROS PANGKAL BONCOS" in large black letters, followed by a smaller paragraph beginning with "Presiden Prabowo memangkas anggaran..." and ending with "H.88". The top margin includes additional text like "Film Pilihan Tempo 2024" and "Siasat Iklim Penangkap Karbon."
